name: dnscontrol-txtpair-v2
instr:
**Our SPF and DKIM records are published with extra quotes (BIND)**

We generate our zones with `dnscontrol push` and the BIND provider; named serves the files it
writes. Since we upgraded dnscontrol, SPF validators say example.com has no SPF record and
receivers can't verify our DKIM signatures. `dig +short TXT example.com` prints the SPF text with a
quote character at each end as part of the value (`"\"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all\""`),
and `_dmarc` and `sel1._domainkey` look the same. The config hasn't changed, e.g.
`TXT("@", "v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all")`. A, MX and CNAME records are fine.

Nothing on our side complained: push and the preview after it run cleanly, and named loads the
zones without warnings.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, as a _test.go file (say ./repro_test.go, next to the code it tests), that fails on the current code because
of this problem (a real test failure, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
wrong too, so please fix it at the source rather than special-casing my input. The f
